gaps.paper_problem: The indicator encoding is claimed to vanish exactly at the zero point, but it is never the zero vector.
gaps.disposition: Prove that its coordinates sum to one, hence it is nonzero, and derive the probability estimate from this identity.
gaps.public_effect: Proof repair only; no public QPBT hypothesis or conclusion changes.

gaps.paper_problem: Magic-Square conditioning omits indicator embeddings and cases; one joint-measurement basis is mistyped.
gaps.disposition: Restore indicator indices, quantify the point domain, use X/Z bases, and enumerate all seven decider edges and both orientations.
gaps.public_effect: Restores the intended tests without strengthening soundness.

gaps.paper_problem: The A.7 proof silently reduces to 6*m*d <= q.
gaps.disposition: Use an internal small-degree helper and discharge the complementary public branch with a proved universal large-error bound.
gaps.public_effect: The source-faithful A.7 and final soundness statements remain unconditional beyond admissibility.

gaps.paper_problem: Isometry suffixes and robustness argument order drift, and epsilon's probability domain is omitted.
gaps.disposition: Use Alice/Bob suffixes consistently, one argument order, and the faithful boundary 0 <= epsilon <= 1.
gaps.public_effect: Typographical normalization plus an explicit probability-domain boundary.

gaps.paper_problem: A.24 proves squared norm while the public theorem states norm, with an invalid delta-for-sqrt-delta substitution.
gaps.disposition: Prove a named square-root robustness bridge, positivity/contraction bounds, and small/large error cases; rechoose universal constants.
gaps.public_effect: Only universal polynomial constants and exponent are reparameterized.

gaps.paper_problem: The source uses prefix len: instead of lem:.
gaps.disposition: Preserve the literal source label in metadata and use a normalized Lean name.
gaps.public_effect: Metadata only.

gaps.paper_problem: The public theorem accepts POVMs while Appendix A begins with projective measurements.
gaps.disposition: Prove one simultaneous local Naimark dilation preserving every game correlation and compose it with extraction isometries.
gaps.public_effect: Discharges an implicit proof boundary without adding an assumption.

gaps.paper_problem: An average over fibers is used as a uniform fixed-fiber linearity premise.
gaps.disposition: Prove a good/bad fiber lemma with threshold eta and average error O(delta/eta + eta).
gaps.public_effect: Internal robustness exponent loss only.

gaps.paper_problem: Arbitrary cross-basis generalized Pauli observables are claimed to commute.
gaps.disposition: State the exact trace phase and specialize only after proving that the phase vanishes.
gaps.public_effect: A false intermediate is weakened; every downstream same-basis use is retained.

gaps.paper_problem: Theorem 7.8 omits field/divisibility hypotheses and has a malformed Reed-Solomon tuple.
gaps.disposition: Expose admissibility and sampler dimension assumptions, correct the code tuple, and prove tensor-code/simultaneous-test adapters.
gaps.public_effect: Narrows the literal internal theorem to the game actually defined.

gaps.paper_problem: The proof invokes LDT in dimension 2*m+2 although admissibility gives only m divides q.
gaps.disposition: Prove a direct Fin n axis LDT and equivalence to the CL-indexed version when divisibility holds.
gaps.public_effect: Preserves the QPBT admissibility assumptions.

gaps.paper_problem: Restricted-line definitions and claims contain punctuation, basis, point-index, missing-property, and complement errors.
gaps.disposition: Formalize all marginals and mixture weights, add Property 3, repair indices and expectations, and state the complement estimate.
gaps.public_effect: Proof repair only.

gaps.paper_problem: A similar-calculation sentence hides the triple-product consistency estimate and the zero-scalar mass.
gaps.disposition: Prove a named Cauchy-Schwarz/projectivity bound and handle alpha = 0 separately.
gaps.public_effect: Fills proof debt without changing A.21.

gaps.paper_problem: Lemma 5.5 quantifies arbitrary tensor length L, but one factor index is ranged through q instead of k, and its final Fourier projector is written with the summed b_j instead of the fixed outcome a_j.
gaps.disposition: Retain arbitrary natural L, range j through the k basis coordinates, and index the resulting single-qubit projector by a_j.
gaps.public_effect: Repairs two indices in the qudit-to-qubit conversion without changing its hypotheses or conclusion.

gaps.paper_problem: The intermediate reversed observable product swaps the r_X/r_Z superscripts and u_X/u_Z arguments, contradicting the lemma statement and the immediately following conclusion.
gaps.disposition: Use Z^(r_Z)(u_Z) X^(r_X)(u_X) in the reversed product throughout the anticommutation argument.
gaps.public_effect: Repairs an internal index typo; the stated observable consequence is unchanged.

gaps.paper_problem: The paper uses one basis with two simultaneous mathematical properties (normal and trace-self-dual), then cites a single uniform deterministic algorithm that also returns compatible multiplication tables in polynomial time. The pinned Lean libraries expose normal-basis and trace-dual machinery separately, but no theorem or executable construction discharges their simultaneous existence and algorithmic coherence for every odd k.
gaps.disposition: First prove simultaneous self-dual-normal-basis existence for GaloisField 2 k from Odd k and make only a noncomputable mathematical selection in F01. Separately formalize or import the pinned Shoup-Lenstra-Wang construction, its multiplication-table output, correctness, representation coherence, and faithful cost bound for K03A.
gaps.public_effect: No field, basis, algorithm, witness package, or correctness premise is added to callers. F01 retains the source's odd-k existence claim, while the stronger uniform algorithm-and-complexity claim remains a separate tracked obligation.

gaps.paper_problem: The paper is unambiguous, but the frozen F04 contract replaced Fact 4.26's heterogeneous Alice/Bob consistency postprocessing by same-space measurement distance and omitted the normalized-state premise from Proposition 4.29.
gaps.disposition: Use POVMConsistencyBigO before and after the same MeasurementFamily.postprocess on Alice/Bob families, and quantify hpsi immediately after psi in both consistency-triangle signatures.
gaps.public_effect: Corrects two planned paper-labelled contracts before implementation; no paper theorem is weakened and no new assumption is exported to callers.

gaps.paper_problem: The top-level convention defines O(g) using one positive constant for every positive integer index, while the local consistency footnote says its O(g) is taken as n tends to infinity, conventionally suggesting an eventual relation.
gaps.disposition: Treat the explicit top-level convention as controlling: use PaperBigO for every paper-facing F04 relation and law conclusion, retain IsBigOAtTop only as an auxiliary, and expose the one-way PaperBigO.isBigOAtTop bridge.
gaps.public_effect: Paper-labelled F04 asymptotic claims use the stronger global positive-index convention; the auxiliary bridge makes their eventual Big-O consequence reusable without asserting a false converse.

gaps.paper_problem: The paper permits an arbitrary admissible field-size function q, hence an arbitrary odd exponent k(n) with q(n) = 2^k(n), but defines one downsized Turing machine that must compute output widths log q(n) from n. It neither supplies that machine with a way to compute the exponent nor charges this computation in TIME_S(n).
gaps.disposition: Require concrete intrinsic FieldExponentProgram data at the faithful Lean executable boundary and define TIME_S(n) to charge both its execution and the sampler's valid queries. Do not fabricate or assert an arbitrary admissible-family-to-machine theorem.
gaps.public_effect: The executable boundary expands TIME_S(n) to charge intrinsic exponent computation; mathematical admissible-family statements are unchanged, and no arbitrary family-to-machine premise or theorem is exposed.

gaps.paper_problem: The downsize statement and proof index an original-field linear map by the downsized prefix downsize(u), although its source-domain index is u. The lemma allows level zero, but its induction proof starts at level one and omits the zero case.
gaps.disposition: Pull a downsized prefix back through the coordinate equivalence before selecting the original linear map, then conjugate that map. Discharge level zero directly with the unique zero certificate.
gaps.public_effect: Internal typing and proof-completeness repairs only; the F06 map and sampler downsize statements are unchanged.

gaps.paper_problem: The line definition permits direction v=0, but the canonical map is invoked with kernel basis {v} although the canonical-complement construction requires a linearly independent set. The decider also asks for the parameter t on a zero-direction line, where every t gives the same point and a reported polynomial need not be constant.
gaps.disposition: Totalize only the degenerate case by canonicalLineProjection 0 = LinearMap.id; represent the singleton through u by (u,0); take the distinguished evaluation parameter t=0; and still check the full incidence equation so every point other than the base rejects.
gaps.public_effect: Nonzero directions use exactly the paper's least-pivot RREF projector. The positive-probability zero event becomes a specified singleton test at coefficient/evaluation parameter zero. No nonzero-direction premise, resampling, conditioning, arbitrary line map, or arbitrary decider input is exposed.

gaps.paper_problem: The chi selector treats a field element as an integer, while the paper specifies only a natural binary representation in the selected basis and does not state which basis coordinate is most significant.
gaps.disposition: Freeze the explicit little-endian boundary index(s) = sum_i bit(D.coordinates s i) * 2^i, with coordinate zero least significant. Prove it is an equivalence with Fin (2^k); the callable fieldElementIndex_testBit theorem states that index bit i equals decide (D.coordinates s i = 1), in the same order used by the project codec.
gaps.public_effect: Only a transparent representation convention is fixed. fieldElementIndex_testBit makes the ordered codec boundary callable. Every chi fiber has size 2^k/m, so a uniform selector remains uniform under any fixed bijective endian convention. No opaque Fintype.equivFin choice is used.
